neutral_calibration.method: median lowest-quartile image ankle separation -> native default stance

limitations: Monocular MediaPipe is an approximate motion prior, not calibrated motion capture.
Root lateral scale assumes 0.30m shoulder width and a fixed front camera.
Root height is grounded native-axis FK on source CAD sole vertices.
IK limb directions and horizontal soles are prioritized; torso roll saturates at native 0.20rad.
